name: Mahjong for a Cause
description: Open play, Mahjong 101 lessons, leagues and tournaments at Hall's Hall in Friendswood (powered by Bam Good Time). Leagues use the 2026 NMJL card.
address: Hall's Hall, 906 Anna Lane, Friendswood, TX 77546
schedule: Open play Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Sat; $10-$15 per session. Mahjong 101 Wednesdays $40 (Nov 25, Dec 2, 9, 23, 30 2026).
evidence_quote: This is not a beginner class! Players should already know how to play American Mahjong and be ready to work on speed, scoring, and strategy.
